pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-brown polygonal regions with irregular, serrated boundaries. Edge gradients are moderately soft. Patches on the upper dorsal and neck regions exhibit larger relative spatial area compared to the smaller, more dispersed patches on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Off-white negative space pathways forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes exhibit 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively wide and consistent throughout the visible torso and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, bristly mane along the dorsal neck with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible against the out-of-focus background.
